company.description:
Rekt Studios is a UAE based technology company specialized in leveraging blockchain and emerging technologies to create cutting edge products and provide consulting
and implementation services. The company’s focus is on creating highly immersive and interactive web3 games, experiences, and virtual environments accompanied by the relevant infrastructure and support to ensure highly functional and complete products. Rekt empowers enterprises and startups to surpassuser expectations by delivering industry-leading products and services.
